purpose: Teach: 移す/解き/外す/謙虚/造り/削っ/抱き/なさら

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室、本気で、絶対、移す、絶対、ことになったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — you're transferring to the research room. I'm counting on you. Seriously.
lines.style: Measured and direct, the voice of someone stating a decision already made. Steady eye contact. A beat of weight on Ren's name. Not unkind, but final.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。問題、本気で、絶対、解き、絶対、明かしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I understand the situation completely. Thank you for trusting me.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude layered under resolve. Respectful but not servile — the tone of someone who knows what he's being asked to do. Slight straightening of posture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、不要な前提、本気で、絶対、外す、絶対、勇気、絶対、持て、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — don't hold yourself back with assumptions you don't need. Have the courage to challenge what isn't working.
lines.style: Firmer now. A light emphasis on 「外す」 — the permission to push back. Still warm underneath, but pushing him toward something larger than deference. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、謙虚、絶対、な、絶対、姿勢、絶対、続けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep moving forward with humility and openness. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Thoughtful and steady. A moment where he absorbs what was just given. Not reflexive politeness — genuine acknowledgment. Breath is even, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の、本気で、絶対、造り、絶対、丁寧にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — make your paper solid. Put the care in. No shortcuts.
lines.style: Sharper here. A slight tap on the command to be careful. Not harsh, but unambiguous. The voice of someone who has seen good work rushed and good work ruined.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費、本気で、絶対、削っ、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm managing the budget carefully and making steady progress. Thank you.
lines.style: Quiet competence. No apology in the voice. He's heard the directive and he's meeting it. Calm, efficient tone. The words land without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、難題、本気で、絶対、抱き、絶対、ながら、絶対、努めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — carry the difficult problems alongside everything else. Keep working through it.
lines.style: Measured and patient. A moment where the pressure lets up just slightly — acknowledgment that the weight is real. Not sympathy, but recognition. Slower pace on this one.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授、本気で、絶対、なさら、絶対、ない、絶対、お決断、絶対、ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I see the decisions you're making, sir — the hard ones. Thank you for holding the line.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Something shifts here — not deference, but respect for what he's witnessing. A small, genuine pause. The gratitude reaches deeper than protocol.
